categoryDefinitions.personal-preference: Interaction behavior retained because it matches the plugin owner's preferred way of working.
categoryDefinitions.team-workflow: Behavior retained to satisfy an organizational policy, convention, or operating constraint.
categoryDefinitions.model-workaround: Behavior retained to compensate for a demonstrated model limitation and expected to be reassessed as models improve.
categoryDefinitions.workflow-enhancement: A capability added because the vanilla workflow does not provide enough value, rigor, or automation.
categoryDefinitions.plugin-management: Knowledge or tooling used for plugin and customization authoring, diagnostics, versioning, publishing, or source maintenance.
categoryDefinitions.reference-utility: Domain knowledge or an operational utility that does not primarily encode a behavioral policy.

integrationRoleDefinitions.standalone: Operates independently and does not primarily exist as part of another customization.
integrationRoleDefinitions.orchestrator: Coordinates named component customizations into a larger workflow.
integrationRoleDefinitions.component: Exists primarily to be invoked as part of an orchestrated customization, even when it is also directly invocable.

customizations.rationale: Provides a broad, evidence-based review workflow beyond the default review behavior.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow provides comparable breadth, evidence validation, and signal without this command.

customizations.rationale: Adds independent specialist reviews and lead synthesis that the vanilla review workflow does not provide.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow provides independent specialist coverage and reliable synthesis with comparable cost and precision.

customizations.rationale: Adds a multi-angle review with explicit evidence and test-sensitivity requirements.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently performs the same multi-angle analysis and rejects unsupported findings.

customizations.rationale: Lets the agent continue a bounded, useful increment when the user is not ready to take over.
customizations.retirementTest: The default interaction continues productive, goal-directed work with the same scope control without this command.

customizations.rationale: Maintains plugin guidance by turning reusable feedback into source-level customization updates instead of one-off exceptions.
customizations.retirementTest: The plugin maintenance workflow handles reusable feedback, source discovery, and change approval without this instruction.

customizations.rationale: Applies the plugin owner's preferred authorship disclosure to automated pull request comment responses.
customizations.retirementTest: The plugin owner no longer wants the disclosure or the platform provides an equivalent disclosure automatically.

customizations.rationale: Keeps pull request descriptions focused on reviewer-relevant intent and observable outcomes rather than routine implementation or CI details.
customizations.retirementTest: The user prefers a different pull request description style or the hosting workflow supplies an equivalent description automatically.

customizations.rationale: Supports publishing an early draft for convenient review while reserving ready-for-review state for changes whose checks pass.
customizations.retirementTest: The preferred workflow no longer uses early draft pull requests or no longer requires passing checks before ready-for-review state.

customizations.rationale: Supplies reusable Rust language and ecosystem guidance across repositories.
customizations.retirementTest: Equivalent authoritative Rust guidance is built into the standard agent workflow or the plugin no longer needs cross-repository Rust guidance.

customizations.rationale: Supplies reusable, framework-neutral TypeScript guidance across repositories.
customizations.retirementTest: Equivalent framework-neutral TypeScript guidance is built into the standard agent workflow or the plugin no longer needs it across repositories.

customizations.rationale: Preserves domain knowledge for correctly interpreting and joining Agent Host and SDK telemetry identifiers.
customizations.retirementTest: Authoritative, maintained platform documentation provides equivalent correlation guidance or the documented telemetry pipelines are retired.

customizations.rationale: Provides a reliable utility for reporting the exact installed plugin version from its source of truth.
customizations.retirementTest: The host reliably exposes the exact active plugin version without a custom skill.

customizations.rationale: Adds focused review of ownership, dependency direction, reuse, and composition.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently finds the same architecture defects with comparable precision and evidence.

customizations.rationale: Adds focused tracing of behavioral contracts, compatibility, state changes, and error semantics.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently finds the same behavioral defects with comparable precision and evidence.

customizations.rationale: Adds focused review of readability, type safety, API clarity, and realistic maintenance risk.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently finds the same maintainability risks without producing stylistic noise.

customizations.rationale: Adds focused review of concrete time, memory, I/O, startup, concurrency, and scaling regressions.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently finds the same performance defects while avoiding speculative optimization findings.

customizations.rationale: Adds focused review of construction, initialization, lifecycle, disposal, operating modes, and concurrency.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently finds the same runtime and lifecycle defects with comparable precision and evidence.

customizations.rationale: Adds explicit analysis of whether tests would catch realistic defects introduced by a change.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard review workflow consistently performs equivalent test-sensitivity and analytical mutation analysis.

customizations.rationale: Adds a reliable source-routing and maintenance workflow for public, experimental, and private customizations.
customizations.retirementTest: Standard customization tooling reliably selects the correct source repository and maintains equivalent classification metadata.

customizations.rationale: Preserves the operational knowledge and reusable files needed to configure and troubleshoot the Agents window background.
customizations.retirementTest: VS Code natively provides the desired build metadata background or the local background workflow is no longer used.

customizations.rationale: Adds a recurring pull request caretaker that avoids duplicate work, acts on clear failures and feedback, and escalates ambiguous risk.
customizations.retirementTest: The standard automation workflow provides equivalent state-aware pull request care and escalation safeguards.
